spanish: Si se levanta y anda afuera sobre su bastón, y quedará limpio el hiriente; solo su cese dará, y sanando sanará.

findings.issue: שִׁבְתּוֹ is the fronted object of יִתֵּן (qal imperfect 3ms: he gives it). "su cese dará" makes the cessation the subject of dará.
Hithpael sequential of הלך is walk-about; "anda" flattens that stem to simple walking.

notes: The other tokens match, including the cognate piel repetition.
